title: Hol-ahvol so'rash

example.en: How are you? I'm fine, thank you.

caption:
0 dan ingliz tili, 3-dars: inglizcha hol-ahvol so'rash.

How are you? — Qalaysiz?
I'm fine — Yaxshiman
Thank you — Rahmat

Bugun qalaysiz? Izohda inglizcha yozing: I'm fine
Saqlab qo'ying va ingliz tilini boshlamoqchi bo'lgan do'stingizga yuboring.
Ertaga 4-dars: Men, sen, u.

#ingliztili #inglizchaoson #0daningliztili #english #uzbekistan
end_say: Saqlab qo'ying! Ertaga to'rtinchi dars: men, sen, u.
